def choose_move(observation):
    px, py = observation.get('self_position', (0, 0))
    ox, oy = observation.get('opponent_position', (px, py))
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    territory_targets = observation.get('territory_targets', [])
    action_options = [-1, 0, 1]
    move_dx, move_dy = 0, 0

    # Seek nearest resource
    if resources:
        res = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r[0]-px)+abs(r[1]-py))
        delta_x = res[0] - px
        delta_y = res[1] - py
        dx = 0 if delta_x == 0 else (1 if delta_x > 0 else -1)
        dy = 0 if delta_y == 0 else (1 if delta_y > 0 else -1)
        if dx in action_options and dy in action_options:
            return [dx, dy]

    # Seek nearest territory target
    if territory_targets:
        tgt = min(territory_targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0]-px)+abs(t[1]-py))
        delta_x = tgt[0] - px
        delta_y = tgt[1] - py
        dx = 0 if delta_x == 0 else (1 if delta_x > 0 else -1)
        dy = 0 if delta_y == 0 else (1 if delta_y > 0 else -1)
        if dx in action_options and dy in action_options:
            return [dx, dy]

    # Pursue opponent
    if ox != px or oy != py:
        delta_x = ox - px
        delta_y = oy - py
        dx = 0 if delta_x == 0 else (1 if delta_x > 0 else -1)
        dy = 0 if delta_y == 0 else (1 if delta_y > 0 else -1)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Default to staying still
    return [0, 0]
